Lemma
[Constant-coefficient weighted oblique estimate] 1. ch6:6.28\group gt-ch06 The same estimate holds for the constant-coefficient operator $L_0$ of Lemma 6.1, with $C=C(n,\alpha ,\lambda ,\Lambda ,b_n/|b|,\operatorname {diam}\Omega )$: \begin{equation} \tag {6.71} |u|^*_{2,\alpha ;\Omega \cup T} \le C\bigl(|u|_{0;\Omega }+|\varphi |_{1,\alpha ;T}+|f|_{0,\alpha ;\Omega }\bigr). \end{equation}
